# lint-known-bad.txt - every line here MUST be caught by at least one pattern.
#
# Two kinds of line live here:
#
#   1. REAL ESCAPES. Text that actually shipped in a public PR body and that the
#      gate of the day failed to stop. These are the regression cases; a pattern
#      edit that stops catching one of them is a coverage loss, and the test says
#      so in those words.
#
#   2. HAND-WRITTEN PARAPHRASES. Written at pattern-authoring time, 5-10 per
#      class. These exist because 17 of the 23 baseline patterns hit NOTHING in
#      the frozen corpus. A zero-hit pattern is unfalsified, not validated - it
#      is precisely the profile the old literal denylist had the day before it
#      failed. Paraphrases are what make incident-driven growth cumulative
#      instead of literal.
#
# Lines starting with '#' are comments and are not asserted.
# Blank lines are ignored.
